children: RAYA HOLDING - BOARD CONDITIONALLY APPROVES SUBSCRIPTION BY RAYA INTEGRATION IN CAPITAL INCREASE OF ITS SUBSIDIARY, RAYA DATA CENTER
RAYA HOLDING - SUBSCRIPTION BY RAYA INTEGRATION N CAPITAL INCREASE OF RAYA DATA CENTER, IN AN AGGREGATE AMOUNT NOT EXCEEDING $60 MILLION
RAYA HOLDING -PROCEEDS OF CAPITAL INCREASE SHALL BE USED EXCLUSIVELY TO FUND EQUITY PORTION OF PURCHASE PRICE PAYABLE IN CONNECTION WITH ACQUISITION

RAYA HOLDING - BOARD CONFIRMS THAT RAYA INTEGRATION'S EQUITY PORTION OF PURCHASE PRICE, OF UP TO $60 MILLION IS AVAILABLE AND UNENCUMBERED
RAYA HOLDING - CAPITAL INCREASE MAY BE IMPLEMENTED IN ONE OR MORE TRANCHES, IN UNITED STATES DOLLARS, EGYPTIAN POUNDS, OR A COMBINATION OF BOTH,
RAYA HOLDING - APPLICABLE EXCHANGE RATE SHALL BE RATE APPLIED BY EXECUTING BANK ON EACH PAYMENT DATE
RAYA HOLDING - NO PART OF THESE FUNDS IS SUBJECT TO ANY LIEN, PLEDGE, OR ENCUMBRANCE
